about: Ratcheted pass-rate floors of the oracle scorecard (test/browser/oracle-scorecard.test.ts): per sample with an oracle SVG in graph-io/test/fidelity/oracles/, per property of test/fidelity/oracle/compare-oracle.ts. Recording keeps the higher of the stored and the measured rate, so a floor is never lowered; an accepted drop goes in allowedDrops as "<sample>/<property>": "<reason>".

allowedDrops.cx-ddram/edge.curve: graphty now draws the EDGE_BEND handles the file stores (edge route 58/109 -> 70/109); two hub edges Cytoscape draws as one smooth curve through the handle are drawn as two segments with a rounded corner, which reads straight
allowedDrops.cx2-syn-bypass/group.present: no longer judged: the one 'group' was a wide edge drawn as a filled band, which the comparison now tells from a group box by its outline
allowedDrops.cys-import-and-save/edge.arrowLength: no longer judged: the comparison now loads the network the oracle draws, where no matched edge has an arrowhead on both sides
allowedDrops.cys-import-and-save/edge.arrowWidth: no longer judged: the comparison now loads the network the oracle draws, where no matched edge has an arrowhead on both sides
allowedDrops.cys-import-and-save/node.shape: no longer judged: the comparison now loads the network the oracle draws (DrugBank, 300 nodes), whose nodes have no shape the oracle can tell
allowedDrops.cys-luad-vest-v2/stray.present: no longer judged: the comparison now loads the network the oracle draws (H. sapiens (10)), and nothing of it is left unassociated
allowedDrops.graphml-stm32-func/edge.arrowLength: four more arrowhead ends now agree (edge.arrow 174/188 -> 178/188); the two new pairs judged for length fail on graphty's oversized arrowheads, the same 61 pass
allowedDrops.xgmml-syn-bypass/edge.arrowWidth: now drawn at the file's positions instead of a force layout, so the arrowheads are measured at the right scale; 12/60 matches cx-syn-bypass (14/64) on the same drawing
